modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Kuwait Airways allows one piece of cabin luggage on all routes, with a weight limit set by class.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Maximum size 56 X 46 X 25 cm (22 X 18 X 10 inch).

weight_economy.value: Economy Class: one piece not exceeding 7 Kgs.

weight_business_first.value: Royal, First and Business Class: one piece not exceeding 11 Kgs.

personal_item.value: In addition, ONE item from: a ladies handbag, a briefcase, a coat, cape or blanket, an umbrella, binoculars or a small camera, crutches or a walking stick, or one duty free item bought on the day of flight.

piece_weight_economy.notes: Kuwait Airways Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: Kuwait Airways Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: Kuwait Airways First Class checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Kuwait Airways' conditions of carriage set out what it offers when it cancels or disrupts a flight, subject to mandatory applicable law.

rebooking.value: If Kuwait Airways cancels a flight, does not operate it reasonably to schedule or causes you to miss a confirmed connection, it may carry you without additional fare on another available Kuwait Airways service, or you can take an involuntary refund of the unused portion. Rerouting on another carrier is at its sole discretion and is not an automatic entitlement, except where mandatory law requires it.

refund.value: Involuntary refund: if no part of the ticket was used, the fare paid less any applicable service charges or cancellation fees; if part was used, the higher of the one-way fare from the point of interruption to the destination or next stopover, or the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the travel used.

us_flights.value: For flights to and from the United States, if Kuwait Airways cancels or significantly changes your flight and you do not accept an alternative, it provides automatic refunds as required under 14 CFR Part 260.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
